meta.source: Al-Qawsan Scientific Bureau — Design System v1.0, September 2026 (brand guidelines document)
meta.note: One light theme. The brand defines no dark mode; dark surfaces are expressed with the navy scale (navy-800 / navy-900) rather than a second theme. The four families ship as real woff2 files. Cairo and IBM Plex Sans Arabic carry Arabic AND Latin, so Western digits, punctuation and Latin brand names inside Arabic copy stay in the same face as the Arabic around them; both also carry the Arabic-Indic digits used in formal correspondence.

tokens.name: navy-50
tokens.usage: Tint of Qawsan Navy. Alternate section backgrounds, GDP/compliance badge grounds, Iraq map governorates that are not hubs.

tokens.name: navy-100
tokens.usage: Navy tint for chart fills behind data, disabled navy surfaces, map fills.

tokens.name: navy-200
tokens.usage: Dividers and borders on navy-50 grounds; never for text.

tokens.name: navy-300
tokens.usage: Fifth chart series, and borders or icons that carry meaning on navy-800 (4.1:1). Text on navy only at 24px, or 19px bold.

tokens.name: navy-400
tokens.usage: Hover state of navy surfaces on dark; hairlines inside the Depth gradient.

tokens.name: navy-500
tokens.usage: Mid navy for illustration fills and hexagon strokes on navy-50.

tokens.name: navy-600
tokens.usage: Illustration fills; borders of navy cards on white.

tokens.name: navy-700
tokens.usage: Top stop of the Depth gradient; hover state of primary buttons is navy-900, not this.

tokens.name: navy-800
tokens.usage: Qawsan Navy, the primary brand colour. Headings, primary buttons, headers and footers, dark panels, text on orange and gold surfaces. 12.2:1 on white.

tokens.name: navy-900
tokens.usage: Deepest navy. Body copy on white, gray-25 and gray-50; primary-button hover; the darkest backgrounds.

tokens.name: orange-50
tokens.usage: Ground for orange badges and tags, paired with orange-700 text.

tokens.name: orange-100
tokens.usage: Soft orange fills in illustrations and chart backgrounds.

tokens.name: orange-200
tokens.usage: Hexagon pattern on orange grounds (see opacity-pattern-strong).

tokens.name: orange-300
tokens.usage: Sixth chart series; pattern layer on orange surfaces.

tokens.name: orange-400
tokens.usage: Illustration fills; light end of small accent bars.

tokens.name: orange-500
tokens.usage: Qawsan Orange. Accent surfaces, CTA fills, stat numbers on navy, focus rings, active underline in the header. Carries navy-800 text; white text only at 24px+ bold.

tokens.name: orange-600
tokens.usage: Hover state of orange-500 surfaces.

tokens.name: orange-700
tokens.usage: Deep Orange — the only orange allowed for small text on white. Overlines, links and link hover on surface and surface-alt. 4.7:1 on white; on orange-50 it drops to 4.3:1, so badge text there steps to orange-800.

tokens.name: orange-800
tokens.usage: Pressed state of orange links, and badge text on orange-50 where orange-700 misses the floor. 6.9:1 on white, 6.4:1 on orange-50.

tokens.name: orange-900
tokens.usage: Deepest orange for print separations and dense illustration shadows.

tokens.name: indigo-50
tokens.usage: Ground for informational notices and CAS sub-brand panels.

tokens.name: indigo-100
tokens.usage: Indigo tint for chart fills and sub-brand tints.

tokens.name: indigo-200
tokens.usage: Borders on indigo-50 grounds.

tokens.name: indigo-300
tokens.usage: Illustration fills on indigo grounds.

tokens.name: indigo-400
tokens.usage: Hexagon pattern layer on navy and indigo grounds (see opacity-pattern-strong).

tokens.name: indigo-500
tokens.usage: Hover state of indigo surfaces.

tokens.name: indigo-600
tokens.usage: Cover Indigo — the secondary brand colour. Secondary backgrounds, links on dark, CAS Development accents, third chart series. 6.0:1 with white text.

tokens.name: indigo-700
tokens.usage: Pressed state of indigo surfaces; indigo text on white.

tokens.name: indigo-800
tokens.usage: Deep indigo panels beside navy.

tokens.name: indigo-900
tokens.usage: Deepest indigo for print and dense panels.

tokens.name: gold-100
tokens.usage: Ground for warning badges, paired with gold-600 or navy-800 text.

tokens.name: gold-300
tokens.usage: Light stop of decorative gold rules and illustration fills.

tokens.name: gold-400
tokens.usage: Arc Gold, from the logo arc. Divider rules, the 3-4px accent bar, gradient start, fourth chart series. Never text — 1.9:1 on white.

tokens.name: gold-600
tokens.usage: Gold dark enough for warning text and icons on gold-100 and white.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Page ground, cards, reversed logo, text on navy, indigo and danger surfaces.

tokens.name: gray-25
tokens.usage: App and alternate section background; packshot ground.

tokens.name: gray-50
tokens.usage: Table zebra rows, input backgrounds, dense table headers.

tokens.name: gray-100
tokens.usage: Default card and table borders, dividers, the white-ground hexagon pattern.

tokens.name: gray-200
tokens.usage: Input borders and notebook ruled lines. 1.5:1 on white — decorative, so an input must also carry its label and a focus state that does not rely on this border.

tokens.name: gray-400
tokens.usage: Placeholder and disabled control text on white, and the seventh chart series. 2.6:1 — never for body copy or for any text that must be read.

tokens.name: gray-600
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, axis labels and business-card titles on surface and surface-alt. 6.0:1 on white, 5.7:1 on gray-25.

tokens.name: gray-800
tokens.usage: Strong secondary text on white and gray-25.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Alias of navy-900. The default body-copy colour on white, gray-25 and gray-50.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Delivered, in stock, approved. 4.1:1 on white and 3.7:1 on success-bg — from the source and kept exact, so use it for icons, dots, rules and text at 19px bold or 24px, and set small badge text in navy-800 beside a success dot. Always paired with a word, never hue alone.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Ground for success badges and row highlights. Carries navy-800 text (10.8:1); success itself only for the dot or icon.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Low stock, pending, expiring. Text and icons on white and warning-bg.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Ground for warning badges and row highlights. Carries navy-800 text (11.2:1); warning only for the dot or icon — warning on this ground is 2.3:1.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Recalls, cold-chain breaks, out of stock, destructive actions and form errors only — never decoration. 5.6:1 on white, 4.9:1 on danger-bg.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Ground for danger badges and error summaries, with danger text.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Notices and tips. Text and icons on info-bg.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Ground for informational notices, with info or navy-800 text.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default page and card ground. Carries text-body, text-heading and text-muted.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Alternating page sections and app chrome. Carries text-body.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Input and table-stripe ground on white. Carries text-body.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Dark panels, headers, footers, brand cards. Carries text-inverse and accent.

tokens.name: surface-accent
tokens.usage: Accent surfaces — CTA buttons, stat tiles, orange cards. Carries on-accent.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: 1px card, table and section borders on white and gray-25.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders and rules that must read at a glance. 3:1 against white.

tokens.name: border-inverse
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers inside navy panels — 2.4:1 on navy-800, so never a control border. A border on navy that carries meaning uses navy-300 (4.1:1).

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Body copy on surface, surface-alt and surface-sunken. 16.8:1 on white, 15.9:1 on gray-25.

tokens.name: text-heading
tokens.usage: Headings and slide titles on surface and surface-alt. 12.2:1 on white.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, helper text and axis labels on surface and surface-alt. 6.4:1 on white.

tokens.name: text-placeholder
tokens.usage: Placeholder and disabled control text on surface and surface-sunken. Never for content.

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse, indigo-600 and danger. 12.2:1 on navy-800.

tokens.name: text-link
tokens.usage: Links and overlines on white and gray-25 — the one orange that passes for small text. 4.7:1.

tokens.name: text-on-dark-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface-inverse and inside the Depth gradient. 6.5:1 on navy-800.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Alias of orange-500 for accent surfaces, stat numbers on navy and the header's active underline.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on surface-accent and on gold-400. 5.3:1 on orange-500, 7.0:1 on gold-400 — use instead of white below 24px.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Alias of gold-400 for the accent bar, dividers and gradient starts. Shapes and rules only.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Qawsan Orange at 65% for the 3px focus ring, drawn outside a 2px offset of the surface. Orange alone is 2.3:1 on white, so a focused control also darkens its border to navy-800 — the two together are the indicator.

families.body-en: "Inter", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif
families.body-ar: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "Segoe UI", Tahoma, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Homepage hero headline and campaign banners. One per page. 36/44px on mobile.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title (About Us, Our Services). 30/38px on mobile.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section title. 26/34px on mobile.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card title and sub-section. 22/30px on mobile.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Small card titles and table section headers. 18/26px on mobile.

styles.name: h5
styles.usage: List group titles and sidebar headers.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow above a title, set in text-link. +8% tracking. English only — never set Arabic this way.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under h1 or h2. 18/28px on mobile.
styles.sample: We connect global healthcare advancements to local needs.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Long-form articles and news. 17/27px on mobile.
styles.sample: Certified medicines, delivered to all 18 governorates.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default paragraph and UI text. Measure 60–75 characters.
styles.sample: Certified medicines, delivered to all 18 governorates.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Card descriptions and secondary information.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Image captions, footnotes, legal lines and chart sources. The smallest English size allowed on screen.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, table headers, tags and badges.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Buttons and navigation links.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: KPI numbers on stat tiles, tabular figures. 36/40px on mobile. Orange on navy, white or navy on orange.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Tables, prices, batch numbers and dosages. Always with tabular figures.

styles.name: ar-display
styles.usage: Hero headline in Arabic — one step above the English display. 40/56px on mobile. Never apply letter-spacing.

styles.name: ar-h1
styles.usage: Page title in Arabic. 34/48px on mobile.

styles.name: ar-h2
styles.usage: Section title in Arabic. 28/40px on mobile.

styles.name: ar-h3
styles.usage: Card title and sub-section in Arabic. 24/34px on mobile.

styles.name: ar-h4
styles.usage: Small card titles and table section headers in Arabic. 20/30px on mobile.

styles.name: ar-h5
styles.usage: List group titles and sidebar headers in Arabic.

styles.name: ar-overline
styles.usage: Eyebrow above an Arabic title, set in text-link. No tracking and no uppercase styling — both break Arabic letter joining.

styles.name: ar-lead
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under an Arabic title. 19/32px on mobile.
styles.sample: نربط التطورات الصحية العالمية بالاحتياجات المحلية.

styles.name: ar-body-lg
styles.usage: Long-form Arabic articles and news. 18/32px on mobile.
styles.sample: أدوية معتمدة تصل إلى جميع المحافظات الثماني عشرة.

styles.name: ar-body
styles.usage: Default Arabic paragraph and UI text. Measure 50–65 characters.
styles.sample: أدوية معتمدة تصل إلى جميع المحافظات.

styles.name: ar-body-sm
styles.usage: Arabic card descriptions and secondary information.
styles.sample: تخزين ونقل وفق ممارسات التوزيع الجيد.

styles.name: ar-caption
styles.usage: Arabic captions, footnotes and sources. The smallest Arabic size allowed on screen.

styles.name: ar-label
styles.usage: Arabic form labels, table headers, tags and badges.

styles.name: ar-button
styles.usage: Arabic buttons and navigation links.

styles.name: ar-data
styles.usage: Arabic tables and data rows. Digits stay Western (0–9) and tabular; the face carries Arabic-Indic digits too, for formal letters that require them.

spacing.note: 4px base. Use multiples of 8 for layout; 4 and 12 only inside components.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and badges; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Label to input; button icon gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card inner gap and the mobile gutter and side margin.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding and the desktop grid gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space between components; the tablet side margin.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space between content blocks; the desktop side margin.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile; the social-post logo safe zone.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags and small badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and form inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and partner-logo tiles.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero media and large feature panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, avatars and number circles.

shadow.note: Shadows are navy-tinted, never neutral black. Elevation is used sparingly — borders carry most separation.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and list rows.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Content cards and stat tiles.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modals, dropdowns and the sticky header once scrolled.

gradient.note: The only three gradients in the identity. Nothing else may be gradated — never a gradient on a hexagon fill or on type.

tokens.name: gradient-arc
tokens.usage: The logo arc, 3–4px accent bars and icon fills.

tokens.name: gradient-horizon
tokens.usage: Hero sections, slide covers and closing slides. Carries white text only.

tokens.name: gradient-depth
tokens.usage: Dark cards and navy panels. Carries text-inverse.

layout.note: Fixed measurements the grid and controls are built from. Breakpoints are min-widths.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Maximum content width at the wide breakpoint.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: Tablet breakpoint — 8 columns, 24px gutter, 32px margin.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: Desktop breakpoint — 12 columns, 24px gutter, 48px margin.

tokens.name: bp-wide
tokens.usage: Wide breakpoint — 12 columns, 32px gutter, centred container.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Site header height.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Default button and input height.

tokens.name: control-height-sm
tokens.usage: Small button height; badge-adjacent controls.

tokens.name: control-height-lg
tokens.usage: Large button height for hero CTAs.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Table row height.

tokens.name: border-width
tokens.usage: Default border on cards, tables and inputs.

tokens.name: border-width-strong
tokens.usage: Secondary-button border.

tokens.name: accent-bar
tokens.usage: The gold-to-orange bar under page headers and above footers.

tokens.name: focus-ring-width
tokens.usage: Focus ring thickness, with a 2px offset.

opacity.note: The hexagon pattern layer only. Nothing else in the identity is set below full opacity except photo overlays, which use navy at 60–80%.

tokens.name: opacity-watermark
tokens.usage: Navy hexagon watermark behind body text on white — the maximum behind reading matter.

tokens.name: opacity-pattern
tokens.usage: Default hexagon pattern layer on covers, footers and section dividers.

tokens.name: opacity-pattern-max
tokens.usage: The hard ceiling for any pattern layer.

tokens.name: opacity-pattern-strong
tokens.usage: Indigo-400 pattern on navy, and orange-300 on orange at 0.35 — tone-on-tone layers that carry no text.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled icons and the muted state of decorative marks.
